name: Kanjiru Majiru Bukkake Seikatsu
original_name: 感汁・魔汁・ぶっかけ性活
source:
A mysterious girl claiming to be a magical girl suddenly appears before main character. He does not believe the girl, so she casts a strange magic spell. Protagonist's dick enlarges and becomes constantly erected. It is going to burst unless it ejaculates enough times to restore to normalcy.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名自称魔法少女的神秘女孩突然出现在主人公面前。他不相信女孩的话，于是她施展了奇怪的魔法。主人公的阴茎变得巨大，并持续勃起；除非射精足够多次，否则就会不断膨胀，最终爆裂。
